sections.title: A ticket that's valid up to somewhere
sections.content: You've used -ig for time (két hétig, "for two weeks"). The same -ig also marks a place as a limit — "as far as" or "up to" — which is exactly how you'll hear a ticket's range described: a jegy Győrig szól means the ticket is valid as far as Győr, and not beyond it.

sections.title: -ig with a place
rows: as far as the next stop
how far does the ticket go?

items.english: My ticket is only valid as far as Győr.
How far does this ticket go?

sections.content: meddig does double duty: with time, it asks "for how long?"; with a place, it asks "how far?" or "up to where?". Context tells you which one is meant, the same way it does in English with "how far".
